section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch22 — Current Affairs 2025
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The Mega DSC-2025 recruitment drive announced by the Andhra Pradesh government was primarily aimed at filling vacancies for:

options.option_text: Teaching posts including SGT, School Assistant, and Physical Education Teacher

explanation: Mega DSC-2025 (Notification 01/Mega-DSC-TRC-1/2025) covers multiple teaching cadres — SGT, School Assistant, TGT, PGT, and Physical Education Teacher posts in AP government/aided/local-body schools.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch22 — National & International Affairs
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: India's first human spaceflight mission under the Gaganyaan programme is being developed to launch astronauts into:

options.option_text: Lunar orbit for a Moon landing

explanation: Gaganyaan aims to send Indian astronauts to Low Earth Orbit (around 400 km altitude) — distinct from Chandrayaan (Moon) or Mangalyaan (Mars) missions, which are uncrewed.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch22 — National & International Affairs
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The Unified Payments Interface (UPI), which enables instant bank-to-bank money transfers via mobile phones in India, was developed by:
explanation: NPCI, an RBI/banks-promoted umbrella organisation, developed and operates UPI. The RBI regulates payment systems but NPCI built and runs the UPI infrastructure itself.
